points.quote: Road construction for approximately 4.2 km of new forest service road will be ongoing along the Sechelt Roberts Branch 01 Forest Service Road between 8.4 km and 9.2 km, and Sechelt Roberts Branch 02 Forest Service Road between 6.3 km and 8.6 km. No road closures are expected; however, road users should be aware of increased industrial traffic and intermittent traffic control.
